title: After Mike DeLisa died: closure and the Burning Spear
summary: His brothers could not run it, it closed and was sold, and the later Burning Spear club failed.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Then after he died, then his brothers -- he had three other brothers, and they tried to run it, but they just didn't have the knowhow to do it. So it just went down, and so pretty soon they had to just close the place and put it up for sale.
No, they didn't open -- anybody didn't open there until -- oh, I guess until about '66, '65 or '66. And then they put that Burning Spear in there.
I was out there one time. Rodney Jones --
Yeah, right, Rodney Jones, right, right.
Yeah, so I was in it. Big place.
Yeah, right, right, right, right, right, right, right.

So they had all of that, they had it going. But they -- it just -- but they didn't know how it had been run before. And then they were just more or less rock and roll people, radio people. And so they had to go the way -- and it didn't last.
